summary: The trace revealed a critical gap in handling ambiguous date formats (DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY) within the same document batch, and invoice-specific total label variations. The agent initially failed on inv_014.jpg (02/14/2024) because it assumed DD/MM format, then fixed it by adding fallback to MM/DD when the first interpretation yields invalid dates. Updates add date disambiguation workflows and invoice total patterns to existing OCR skill.
